notes: Built for an Episode I-only tournament format: the title says 'EP1' and the description and strategy say it is for an 'EP:1 Tournament setting' / 'EP1 format'.

Starting cards as posted under Starting (7): We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates, Inner Strength, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core, Mindful Of The Future (starting interrupt), Brisky Morning Munchen and An Unusual Amount Of Fear; these count toward the 60.
Posted Control, Sense and Alter dested the Light Coruscant printings (Control (Coruscant), Sense (Light) (Coruscant), Alter (Light) (Coruscant)) because the deck is built for the Episode I format.
Posted 'Qui-Gons Lightsaber (R3)' dested Qui-Gon's Lightsaber and 'Obi-Wans Lightsaber (R3)' dested the Reflections III Obi-Wan's Lightsaber.

Posted 'Mace Windu. Jedi Master' dested Mace Windu, Jedi Master; 'Ric Ole' dested Ric Olie; 'Eventully You'll Lose' dested Eventually You'll Lose; 'Queens Royal Starship' dested Queen's Royal Starship.
Shields: Another Pathetic Lifeform and Don't Do That Again dested the Defensive Shield printings, not the Coruscant/Tatooine Effects of the same names.
